verses.en: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.pt: A ti, ó Deus, é devido o louvor em Sião; e a ti se pagará o voto.
verses.en_web: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. A Song.> It is right for you, O God, to have praise in Zion: to you let the offering be made.

verses.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.pt: Ó tu que ouves a oração! a ti virá toda a carne.
verses.en_web: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.
verses.en_bbe: To you, O hearer of prayer, let the words of all flesh come.

verses.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.pt: Prevalecem as iniqüidades contra mim; mas as nossas transgressões, tu as perdoarás.
verses.en_web: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
verses.en_bbe: Evils have overcome us: but as for our sins, you will take them away.

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado aquele a quem tu escolhes, e fazes chegar a ti, para habitar em teus átrios! Nós seremos satisfeitos com a bondade da tua casa, do teu santo templo.
verses.en_web: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man of your selection, to whom you give a resting-place in your house; we will be full of the good things out of your holy place.

verses.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.pt: Com prodígios nos respondes em justiça, ó Deus da nossa salvação, a esperança de todas as extremidades da terra, e do mais remoto mar;
verses.en_web: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;
verses.en_bbe: You will give us an answer in righteousness by great acts of power, O God of our salvation; you who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of the far-off lands of the sea;

verses.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.pt: tu que pela tua força consolidas os montes, cingido de poder;
verses.en_web: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;
verses.en_bbe: The God by whose strength the mountains are fixed; who is robed with power:

verses.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.pt: que aplacas o ruído dos mares, o ruído das suas ondas, e o tumulto dos povos.
verses.en_web: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
verses.en_bbe: Who makes the loud voice of the sea quiet, and puts an end to the sound of its waves.

verses.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.pt: Os que habitam os confins da terra são tomados de medo à vista dos teus sinais; tu fazes exultar de júbilo as saídas da manhã e da tarde.
verses.en_web: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
verses.en_bbe: Those in the farthest parts of the earth have fear when they see your signs: the outgoings of the morning and evening are glad because of you.

verses.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.pt: Tu visitas a terra, e a regas; grandemente e enriqueces; o rio de Deus está cheio d'água; tu lhe dás o trigo quando assim a tens preparado;
verses.en_web: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
verses.en_bbe: You have given your blessing to the earth, watering it and making it fertile; the river of God is full of water: and having made it ready, you give men grain.

verses.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.pt: enches d'água os seus sulcos, aplanando-lhes as leivas, amolecendo-a com a chuva, e abençoando as suas novidades.
verses.en_web: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
verses.en_bbe: You make the ploughed lands full of water; you make smooth the slopes: you make the earth soft with showers, sending your blessing on its growth.

verses.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.pt: Coroas o ano com a tua bondade, e as tuas veredas destilam gordura;
verses.en_web: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
verses.en_bbe: The year is crowned with the good you give; life-giving rain is dropping from your footsteps,

verses.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.pt: destilam sobre as pastagens do deserto, e os outeiros se cingem de alegria.
verses.en_web: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
verses.en_bbe: Falling on the grass of the waste land: and the little hills are glad on every side.

verses.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.pt: As pastagens revestem-se de rebanhos, e os vales se cobrem de trigo; por isso eles se regozijam, por isso eles cantam.
verses.en_web: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
verses.en_bbe: The grass-land is thick with flocks; the valleys are full of grain; they give glad cries and songs of joy.
